channel.title: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator" - A motel with an elevator? Weird, but It's definitely just there for show, right...right?

item.title: Re: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded:
Well, they don’t have to find something to do with it. I was just spitting some suggestions for where you could take the story around the anomaly.

The idea of having a D-class enter his own mind could be interesting. If done well, articles that humanize the Ds are often well received. I would warn you, however, not to spread the anomaly over too many different funky room types without having some sort of unifying theme or explanation.

item.title: Re: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded:
Is some entity collecting samples of other universes? Is this a secret wing of the hotel that caters to beings from other realities?

Those two sound like good ideas.

Are the things inside related to the person doing the exploring?

Funny thing is, I was actually thinking about making a specific door that has the ability to go inside the person's mind and recreate settings from what they remember before they became D-Class.

How can the Foundation utilize this anomaly?

Sadly, I'm still trying to find out how they can use the SCP's anomaly, but I'll think of something. I'm sure of it.

item.title: Re: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded: I enjoy anomalies that are weird, wrong buildings like this one and SCP-455. However, you will need to do something to make yours stand out from the already very large number of anomalies that are weird buildings full of weird things with weird exploration logs. Perhaps create some sort of narrative, something that ties together these hotel rooms as something other than random weird shit. Is some entity collecting samples of other universes? Is this a secret wing of the hotel that caters to beings from other realities? Are the things inside related to the person doing the exploring? How can the Foundation utilize this anomaly? You needn’t answer these questions necessarily, but I do recommend including some mystery about the anomaly’s purpose or nature and either implying the solution or revealing it in the exploration logs.

item.title: Re: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded:
Yeah, I had a feeling it was considered a pocket dimension.

Will do!

I was thinking about going to thecritter for help the second I posted this, but I wanted to wait for some weird reason. I'm gonna go there soon!

Thanks!

item.title: Re: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded:
Overall, this is a fun idea.

1) Minor Quibble: It's not "non-existent" so much as a "pocket dimension". Just works better thematically.

2) Emphasize that curiosity is a major part of the hook. It's almost as if you are dancing around it, but you need to place it squarely in your sites.

3) You may want to pester some of the reviewers. This has some potential to be an SCP, but you need to bother them to get it reviewed.

item.title: A Motel With An Elevator
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Standard layout + Incident/exploration/interview logs

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is an elevator behind a motel that can take you to pocket dimensions with doors that have weird stuff behind them

Genre: Horror and a little bit of comedy and emotion.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: In 2010, The manager of Moonlight Shores went to the back of the motel to have a quick smoke break. While he was smoking, he noticed an elevator near him. He never noticed there was an elevator because he would always smoke at the back of the motel, so he entered the elevator out of curiosity and saw that there are only six numbered buttons on the panel. He pressed on one of the buttons, and the elevator took him to a hallway full of rooms. He tried to open one of the doors but failed because it was locked. He tried using his management key to open it but failed again. As a last resort, he looked through the keyhole to see what was inside. after seeing what was inside, he started to panic and quickly ran back inside the elevator returning to our world. He then called the police and told them he saw a room that had eyeballs for walls and saw ordinary objects wrapped in human flesh. After investigation, the police contacted the Foundation, and then the Foundation purchased the property for testing.

D-personnel will be asked to open a few doors and video-tape what they see or find along the way.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Each door has something special. One door could lead to a parallel-universe of earth, but it was taken over by an unknown species of animals. One door could lead you into a room that looks luxurious, but if you stay in there long enough. Its looks fade away and you're left with a room that looks abandoned. One door can be just a room filled with clown paintings, and those paintings can make the person that looks at them laugh to death (literally). Who knows!

Additional Notes: Since all the doors are locked. I was thinking about using SCP-005 to help open the doors. I know people don't like the idea of older SCP cross-linking to the newer ones, so If you guys don't like the idea of these two SCPs cross-linking, I'll leave it alone.

Not all the doors are gonna lead you into a room or if it does, it won't always be a room filled with some monstrosity every time. just wanted to let you guys know, so you won't get confused.
